messages:
alex: Kickoff: Ion7B int4 pass shows progressive repetition on long chat sessions. Short prompts fine but multi-turn QA repeats phrase blocks from earlier context. Anyone familiar with Ion quirks?
sara: saw similar with another model. Did you check head-splitting / tile packing? Ion exports with 'chiplet_head_splits' for optimized kernels.
dmitri: paste the quant command please.
alex: `redwood-quantize --model ion7b --dtype int4 --group 64 --tilepack auto --calib 2048`
alex: quick stats: fp16 baseline top1 0.65, int4 top1 0.47 after 1.2k tokens. Latency improved but quality tanked.
sara: tilepack=auto likely triggered head-splitting. exporter should also permute rotary and kv layout. run inspect-layout.
dmitri: ran `inspect-layout ion7b --verbose` on int4 artifact. Output: `head_layout: [0,1,4,5,2,3,...]` but rotary_angles array is unchanged -> mismatch.
qa-bot: eval/ion7b-int4-nightly: longchat-repeat-rate +23% (alert)
alex: tokenizer note: Ion tokenizer uses soft-hyphen as a token glue for compound words. Our tokenizer shim normalizes soft-hyphen to hyphen-minus, causing aliasing. Example upstream ids: [11,222,333] our shim: [11,45,222,333]. That inserted extra id shifts kv indices.
sara: so two simultaneous problems: head permutation without permuting per-head params + tokenizer id insertion leading to kvcache desync.
dmitri: for immediate triage: 1) re-quant with `--tilepack linear --no-headsplit` 2) run `--preserve-rotary` 3) patch tokenizer loader to keep soft-hyphen as-is.
alex: i ran linear/no-headsplit smoke: int4 linear top1 0.63, repeats reduce significantly. quick logs:
[2026-04-02T09:02:11Z] ion7b.fp16: tokens=1200,top1=0.65,lat=90ms
[2026-04-02T09:02:11Z] ion7b.int4.linear: tokens=1200,top1=0.62,lat=58ms
sara: good. follow-ups: exporter change to apply head permutation to `rotary_angles`, `kv_order`, and any per-head adapter params. add a conversion assert: after reordering, running `inspect-layout --check` should pass.
dmitri: tokenizer fix PR #1118 submitted to preserve soft-hyphen normalization and run roundtrip tests. also added `kv-offset-check` to onboarding harness.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: ion7b-int4-linear -> dedicated-canary-8 at 2026-04-03T02:30:00Z.
alex: note to docs: avoid `--tilepack auto` until exporter ensures metadata permutation. add onboarding checklist entry.
sara: also add a unit that compares per-head rotary dot-products between fp16 and quant for first 32 tokens to surface sign/scale flips early.
qa-bot: queued longchat regression suite run for int4.linear variant.
dmitri: thanks. will monitor. tagging @sara @alex for followups.
